headerDictionary.O*NET-SOC Code: Exact occupation identifier, including disaggregated suffix
headerDictionary.Title: Published occupation title
headerDictionary.Element ID: Published software-skill category identifier; retained as string
headerDictionary.Hot Technology: Raw Y/N source classification; not a percentage, count, rank or proficiency score
headerDictionary.In Demand: Raw Y/N occupation-specific source classification; N does not mean zero demand

interpretation.N: Not flagged in this source, not zero demand or no relevance
interpretation.ordering: Original CSV source order; not a ranking
interpretation.scope: Occupation-level software references. Not observed company skills, applicant supply or training duration. Full code matching only; broader wage SOC must not substitute for disaggregated duty code.
